description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with Effect From 13.05.2024 to 19.05.2024.
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and represents a statutory instrument issued by the Director General of Customs under delegated authority. The content focuses on legal/regulatory compliance requirements rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
